conditions.gpu_cpu: RTX 3060 / NVIDIA 610.88; Core i5-14600KF; Windows x64; Rust 1.99.0
conditions.cpu_active: build_snapshot start through submit return; excludes snapshot, cold upload and waits
conditions.gpu_interval: Whole Graph including readback; excludes presentation
conditions.limits: One machine/driver; clock, affinity, power and OS load not controlled. Before and after intentionally change validation/diagnostic configuration; these samples do not isolate one optimization, establish causation or imply an FPS improvement. Shipping zero diagnostic counters are not observation of native validation or proof against external layer injection.

correctness.measurement_limits: CPU active excludes capacity waits; GPU includes readback, excludes presentation. Observed latency starts after submit return and ends at completion observation, not scanout. No clock/affinity/power control or performance baseline.

performance.measurement_limits: CPU active excludes capacity waits; GPU includes readback, excludes presentation. Observed latency starts after submit return and ends at completion observation, not scanout. No clock/affinity/power control or performance baseline.

retained_graph_heap.method: Normal release library (cfg(test) false), 1024 buffer resources; drop Graph, count allocator-requested bytes held by CompiledGraph before dump, then drop plan and assert live bytes return to baseline. Not allocator overhead, stack, process RSS or VRAM. One run per configuration/case.
